suite: Smart Cart Autonomy Lab core regression

tests.name: Config rejects out-of-range and invalid typed values
Seeded world and sensor noise are deterministic
Obstacle counts and independent type selection
Keyboard input normalization and configured speed
Pause freezes simulation time and dynamics
Stationary target is approached and held without contact
Moving user is followed from sensor estimates, then cart stops
Columns trigger steering and are passed autonomously
Mixed dense environment: progressing, replanning, no contact in reference route
Independent pedestrians move, fixed columns do not
Low boxes appear in forward ToF but not an elevated planar LiDAR
Ray-cast occlusion returns the first surface
UWB records line-of-sight obstruction and reduced quality
Initial rear-side range measurements do not invent an unambiguous bearing
Out-of-range UWB has no fix
UWB failure initiates safe stop
LIDAR failure initiates safe stop
TOF failure initiates safe stop
E-stop is latched and wheel motion ceases
Ascending stairs stop the cart; no wheel spin after settling
Excessive grade is a known-map no-go area
Mild up and downhill match terrain height and finite motor values
Finite modeled parking brake holds a supported slope
Ackermann front-wheel angles differ on a turn
Movable box receives contact impulse; fixed obstacle does not move
Lighting changes optical stress but darkness does not disable UWB
Planner does not read obstacle ground truth or world ray queries
Flutter telemetry has compatible fields, null cliff, explicit synthetic semantics
No-return ranges are null in ToF and zero-coded in LiDAR wire output
Procedural cart has independent animated meshes and finite geometry
